terms.gloss: the topaz of the ancients (a green stone, perhaps chrysolite)
terms.comment: Pliny’s topazos was a greenish stone, not the yellow gem we call topaz; the name is the same.
Traupman gives the word as an adjective. Lewis & Short has topazius only as a late noun for the stone (Tertullian), and marks its vowels short: tŏpazĭus.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 396.
